collection.title: Vauxhall VXR8 2007 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall VXR8 2007 to 2017 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
